parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of file titles and error messages. Valid values:

*   **zh** (default): simplified Chinese.
*   **en**: English.
*   **ja**: Japanese.
*   **zh-tw**: traditional Chinese.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-download-records --db-cluster-id am-0000000000000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
